name: uv-mcp
description: Bridge modern, reproducible Python environments with Gemini CLI agents. Diagnose, self-heal, and manage uv workflows.
author: Saadman Rafat

settings.name: Default Project Workspace Path
settings.description: Absolute host directory to mount for Python environment evaluations. All project_path arguments are validated against this root — paths outside it are rejected.

settings.name: Allowed Tools Allowlist
settings.description: Comma-separated list of PyPI package names that may be run or installed (e.g. ruff,black,mypy). When set, uv_run_ephemeral_tool, uv_tool_install, and uv_tool_upgrade reject any package not in this list.

settings.name: Forced Text Interception
settings.description: Silence ANSI color tokens and terminal control sequences in all subprocess output.

settings.name: Dumb Terminal Mode
settings.description: Strip terminal escape sequences by forcing TERM=dumb on spawned uv processes.
